decision: Remove all foundation-to-Aethel dependencies. Aethel owns aethel-deccp, aethel-dekyx, aethel-zkpi and aethel-defmi-host; default DeFMI uses NoApplications and never decodes application-specific state.
rationale: User explicitly requested foundation-wide Aethel independence and a Canton comparison delegated to Claude Fable 5.1 Max. Existing app snapshots require explicit migration; no live chain reset is implied.
